name: Entity
doc: An entity in a scene or prefab. Components are stored inline under their type names; a prefab instance stores prefab plus overrides instead.

fields.name: parent
fields.doc: Parent entity, or none for a root. May point inside a prefab instance (e_4f9a/m4tz).

fields.name: order
fields.doc: Fractional-index key ordering the entity among its siblings.

fields.name: prefab
fields.doc: The prefab this entity instantiates. Instances carry overrides, not components.

fields.name: overrides
fields.doc: Prefab overrides keyed by [<id path>/]<field path>, such as m4tz/MeshRenderer.mesh or Transform.position.

fields.name: removed
fields.doc: Prefab entities (m4tz) or components (m4tz/Light) removed from this instance.
